findings.evidence: bt-result-flow is a vertical flex flow and bt-primary-chart-grid, bt-diagnostic-grid, bt-equal-card-grid and bt-gui-parity-cards resolve to one grid column.
diagnosticsOpen defaults false and the diagnostic grid is conditionally mounted only when true.
The shared result area requires the Backtest stage and an exact known run/generation source.
The standard writer owns one section sequence and one renderer with system/light/dark display radios.
Run comprehensive reports independently own the navy/gold masthead, KPI, SVG visualization and light-only stylesheet.
The chart engine preference falls back to live Canvas.
The Canvas reserves 48 slots and draws the latest-price guide across the plot width.
The one-second aggregation branch can consume raw day-layout open/high/low columns instead of current-price observation buckets.
The tab query is evaluated before pathname mapping, so /ui/evolution/workbench?tab=research mounts Research Live.
/ui/v4/ and allowed /ui/evolution routes serve the same v4.html response.
